name: NAADP binder exhaustive hunt (everything)
description: The all-in-one default: Compara paralog mine, ortholog expansion, InterPro Pfam enumeration, merged into a census, then every analysis plus discovery scoring and the presence/absence matrix. Takes 5-15 min against live APIs. Carry JPT1 into every JPT analysis set — it is the decoy the whole project turns on. The presence/absence matrix is the deliverable that matters most here: binder presence against two-pore-channel presence, lineage by lineage.
